preconditions.description: The input integer n is within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if a valid sequence exists, or 'NO' if it does not.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in sequence)
invariants.description: Each element in the sequence is a positive integer no larger than n.
The sequence contains exactly n elements.

invariants.expression: all(ai != aj for i < j for ai, aj in combinations(sequence, 2))
invariants.description: All elements in the sequence are distinct.
The prefix product sequence is a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n - 1].
